title:
One little idea.
One real night.
intro: Less “someday”. More “shall we try?” A night at Đường 1 Chill could be our first small experiment.
birthdayText: Would you like to turn a celebration into our first experiment together at Đường 1 Chill? Your birthday, your call. No party committee required.

party: Keep it simple. Make it yours.
partyText: One welcoming night. People arriving alone should feel welcome. Choose two or three activities, not a festival.

editor: These are your answers, Phương—you can type here and save. Yan can read them; you can both vote on ideas and leave messages.

ideas.title: A little idea menu
ideas.intro: What would make people come—and feel comfortable meeting someone new? Pick favourites together. Two or three good ideas are enough.
ideas.note: Ideas to discuss, not booked offers. Yan / Dalat.app proposes funding the welcome drink, photography and small bites; agree on the total budget, quantities and venue approval first. Voting does not commit money or publish anything.
ideas.error: Could not save. Please try again.
ideas.hint: Each tap saves your own vote. Both names stay visible. Refresh to see the latest votes; suggest another idea in the message box below.

drink.title: RSVP → one welcome drink
drink.description: RSVP on Dalat.app, then check in for one welcome drink funded by Yan. Include a non-alcoholic choice. Agree the cap, drink options and cost first.

photos.title: Come for the night, return for the photos
photos.description: A relaxed photographer and an easy gallery link afterward, funded by Yan. Ask before photographing people. Photos remain accessible without RSVP or forced registration.

meet.title: Meet three new people
meet.description: A friendly host welcomes people arriving alone. Three optional prompts: your name, a favourite Đà Lạt spot, something you would love to learn.

bites.title: A few delicious little bites
bites.description: Dalat.app could fund a small tray of vegetarian finger food. Agree portions and costs with the venue; label ingredients and allergens.

bingo.title: People bingo
bingo.description: A tiny bilingual card: find someone who grows plants, speaks three languages or knows a hidden café. Aim for conversations, not a race to collect contacts.

photo-challenge.title: Best new-friends photo
photo-challenge.description: Mixed teams make a funny, creative photo. Only submit with everyone’s consent. Guests choose the most joyful photo—not the most attractive person. Tiny optional prize.

language.title: Teach me one phrase
language.description: Pairs teach each other one useful Vietnamese or English phrase, then swap after five minutes. All language levels welcome; passing is fine.

local-tips.title: The local secret wall
local-tips.description: Write a favourite local place or activity in either language. A volunteer helps translate. Instant conversation starters and a mini city guide.

teams.title: Đà Lạt mini quiz
teams.description: Three short rounds in mixed Vietnamese/international teams. Local food, places and funny city facts; read every question in both languages.

music.title: One song from home
music.description: Guests suggest one song that means something to them. The venue chooses a few for its playlist; conversation stays possible at a comfortable volume.

name-tags.title: Hello, I’m…
name-tags.description: Optional name stickers with languages you speak or want to practise and one interest. No forced singles labels or relationship questions.

postcards.title: Postcard to a new friend
postcards.description: Draw or write a two-minute Đà Lạt postcard and exchange it with someone you just met. Funny drawings welcome; no artistic talent needed.

birthday.title: A tiny birthday moment
birthday.description: If Phương wants it: a small cake, a short toast and a group photo for those who opt in. Five minutes, then back to the evening.

body-art.title: Live body-art performance
body-art.description: Optional stretch idea: Dalat.app could hire a professional adult model and artist for tasteful body painting. Agree pay, coverage, consent, photography and venue fit first. Could simpler face/hand painting work better?
body-art.effort: Higher cost · not a first-night essential
